description: Decide whether a supplier invoice is safe to pay in two independent stages: match the invoice against its purchase order and goods receipt line by line, with quantity, price-tolerance, and totals checks plus duplicate-invoice suspicion screening (ART-701), then recompute the invoice's line VAT, tax subtotals, and grand total under the declared rounding convention and compare against the document-asserted amounts (ART-294), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Arithmetic checks only; not a fraud determination and not tax advice.
name: supplier-invoice-three-way-match-check
regulatory_refs: EN 16931 electronic invoicing (VAT category codes; rate correctness not assessed)

steps.handoff: Matches the invoice against its purchase order and goods receipt: every line paired to a PO line with quantity-over-received, quantity-over-ordered, and price-tolerance verdicts, totals recomputed in minor units, and duplicate-invoice suspicion screening against prior invoices; outcome match, mismatch, no_po, or refused

Recomputes the invoice's line VAT, per-category tax subtotals, tax total, and grand total under the declared rounding convention and compares each against the document-asserted amounts; arithmetic consistency only, not statutory rate correctness
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Supplier Invoice Three-Way Match Check
